parsed.post: Discarding the latest attempt (1.030083). It seems the reduction in learning rate to 0.04 is too slow for our 5-minute training budget. Reverting to my best commit (0.988844) with MATRIX_LR=0.06. Next, I'll test increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to increase model width and capacity.
